//: Hand-written correctness fixture. All object/subject IDs are namespaced 'vec-' so
//2: TestVectors can DELETE FROM spike.tuple WHERE object_id LIKE 'vec-%' OR subject_id LIKE 'vec-%'
//3: and re-insert idempotently without disturbing the loadgen dataset that shares the table.

vectors.name: system-superadmin-direct
vectors.why: system#superadmin is a bare [user] this-tuple

vectors.name: system-superadmin-wrong-user
vectors.why: no tuple for this user on system#superadmin

vectors.name: module-admin-via-superadmin-ttu
vectors.why: module#admin = this or (superadmin from system); no direct tuple, resolves via tupleToUserset(system,superadmin)

vectors.name: module-editor-via-computed-admin-chain
vectors.why: module#editor = this or admin; admin itself resolves via the system ttu two hops down

vectors.name: module-editor-deny-unrelated-user
vectors.why: vec-c1-admin has no relation to module:vec-mod1 at all

vectors.name: company-admin-direct
vectors.why: company#admin this-tuple, direct grant

vectors.name: company-viewer-via-computed-admin
vectors.why: company#viewer = this or admin; vec-c1-admin has no direct viewer tuple, reaches it via computedUserset(admin)

vectors.name: company-viewer-direct
vectors.why: company#viewer direct this-tuple, union short-circuits on the first child

vectors.name: company-viewer-deny-empty-company
vectors.why: company:vec-c2 carries zero tuples: deny on missing tuple

vectors.name: company-module-admin-via-company-ttu
vectors.why: company_module#admin includes (admin from company); vec-c1-admin only holds company:vec-c1#admin

vectors.name: company-module-admin-direct
vectors.why: direct this-tuple on company_module#admin

vectors.name: company-module-editor-via-admin
vectors.why: company_module#editor = this or admin; vec-c1-m1-admin has no direct editor tuple

vectors.name: company-module-viewer-union-editor
vectors.why: viewer = this or editor or submitter or approver or admin; short-circuits on the editor child

vectors.name: company-module-viewer-union-submitter
vectors.why: reaches viewer via the submitter child of the same union

vectors.name: company-module-viewer-union-approver
vectors.why: reaches viewer via the approver child

vectors.name: company-module-viewer-userset-subject-expansion
vectors.why: company_module#viewer carries a userset-subject tuple to company:vec-c1#viewer; vec-c1-viewer holds that company relation directly

vectors.name: company-module-viewer-userset-subject-expansion-via-admin
vectors.why: same userset-subject tuple, but the concrete subject reaches company:vec-c1#viewer via company#admin instead of a direct viewer grant

vectors.name: company-module-submitter-deny-disabled-path
vectors.why: submitter is a bare this-tuple with no union fallback; an editor is NOT a submitter

vectors.name: company-module-approver-deny-disabled-path
vectors.why: approver has no union fallback either

vectors.name: company-member-userset-subject-via-mapped-user
vectors.why: company#member is a [member#mapped_user] this-tuple (the org-written membership fact); vec-mem1-user reaches it through member:vec-c1-mem1#mapped_user

vectors.name: company-module-member-via-company-ttu
vectors.why: the timesheet/notification fragment shape: company_module#member = this or (member from company) or admin; an active linked member reaches it via tupleToUserset(company,member) with zero module-level tuples

vectors.name: company-module-member-direct
vectors.why: direct this-tuple on company_module#member

vectors.name: company-module-member-via-admin
vectors.why: admin implies member (computedUserset admin child); vec-c1-m1-admin holds no member tuple

vectors.name: company-module-member-cross-company-deny
vectors.why: vec-mem1-user is a member of company:vec-c1 only; company_module:vec-c2-m1 is anchored on company:vec-c2, whose member set is empty

vectors.name: company-module-member-no-tuple-deny
vectors.why: vec-c1-viewer holds company#viewer, which is not membership; no member/admin path exists

vectors.name: company-module-empty-company-admin-deny
vectors.why: company_module:vec-c2-m1's parent company:vec-c2 has no admin tuple at all

vectors.name: member-directory-owner-direct
vectors.why: member_directory#owner this-tuple

vectors.name: member-directory-editor-via-owner
vectors.why: editor = this or owner or admin or (editor from company_module); reaches via computedUserset(owner)

vectors.name: member-directory-editor-via-company-module-ttu
vectors.why: reaches editor via tupleToUserset(company_module,editor); vec-c1-m1-editor never touched the directory directly

vectors.name: member-directory-viewer-via-editor-chain
vectors.why: viewer = this or editor or owner or admin; multi-hop through editor's own union

vectors.name: member-directory-create-deny
vectors.why: create = this or admin; vec-dir1-owner is neither

vectors.name: member-owner-via-directory-ttu
vectors.why: member#owner = this or (owner from directory) or admin; vec-dir1-owner only holds the directory's owner relation

vectors.name: member-owner-via-deep-admin-chain
vectors.why: member#admin -> (admin from company_module) -> company_module#admin -> (admin from company) -> company#admin this-tuple: 4 hops

vectors.name: member-owner-deny
vectors.why: vec-outsider has no path to member:vec-c1-mem1 at all

vectors.name: project-owner-via-directory-ttu
vectors.why: project#owner = (owner from directory) or admin; NO direct [user] alternative in the model

vectors.name: project-can-assign-via-owner
vectors.why: can_assign = owner or admin; reached through the owner computedUserset

vectors.name: project-viewer-via-directory-viewer-ttu
vectors.why: project#viewer includes (viewer from directory); project_directory holds a direct viewer grant

vectors.name: project-owner-deny-random-user
vectors.why: vec-c1-m1-editor has editor rights on the company_module but none on the project's directory chain, and is not company_module admin

vectors.name: timesheet-entry-viewer-direct
vectors.why: direct this-tuple grant

vectors.name: timesheet-entry-owner-via-mapped-user
vectors.why: owner = this or (mapped_user from member) or admin; vec-mem1-user is the member's mapped_user, reached via tupleToUserset(member,mapped_user)

vectors.name: timesheet-entry-viewer-via-mapped-user
vectors.why: same mapped_user path but for the viewer relation

vectors.name: timesheet-entry-viewer-via-project-directory-chain
vectors.why: viewer includes (viewer from project); project#viewer itself reaches through (viewer from directory) — a 3-hop tupleToUserset chain

vectors.name: timesheet-entry-editor-via-company-module-ttu
vectors.why: editor includes (editor from company_module) directly

vectors.name: timesheet-entry-can-edit-via-owner
vectors.why: can_edit = editor or owner; mapped_user path gives owner, which satisfies can_edit

vectors.name: timesheet-entry-viewer-deny
vectors.why: vec-seg1-owner has no relation whatsoever to this timesheet_entry or its parents

vectors.name: submission-owner-via-mapped-user
vectors.why: submission#owner = this or (mapped_user from member) or admin

vectors.name: submission-viewer-via-company-module-editor-ttu
vectors.why: submission#viewer includes (editor from company_module) directly

vectors.name: submission-viewer-deny
vectors.why: vec-pdir1-owner has no relation to this submission

vectors.name: document-shared-viewer-direct
vectors.why: shared_viewer is an isolated this-tuple plane, independent of the parent chain

vectors.name: document-viewer-via-timesheet-entry-ttu
vectors.why: document#viewer includes (viewer from timesheet_entry); reuses the te1 mapped_user chain 2 hops further down

vectors.name: document-viewer-via-deep-project-chain
vectors.why: document#viewer -> viewer from timesheet_entry -> viewer from project -> viewer from directory: 3 tupleToUserset hops

vectors.name: document-admin-via-timesheet-entry-company-module-chain
vectors.why: document#admin -> admin from timesheet_entry -> admin from company_module -> this: 3 hops

vectors.name: document-shared-viewer-deny
vectors.why: shared_viewer never inherits — a document viewer via the parent chain is NOT a shared_viewer

vectors.name: document-viewer-deny-outsider
vectors.why: vec-outsider has no relation to any parent of this document

vectors.name: module-role-binding-member-direct
vectors.why: member is a bare this-tuple

vectors.name: module-role-binding-admin-via-company-module-ttu
vectors.why: admin = (admin from company_module) or (superadmin from system); no direct alternative

vectors.name: module-role-binding-admin-via-system-ttu
vectors.why: reaches admin through the system superadmin branch instead

vectors.name: module-role-binding-member-deny
vectors.why: vec-rb1-member has the member relation, not admin's targets

vectors.name: access-bundle-manager-direct
vectors.why: manager this-tuple

vectors.name: access-bundle-admin-via-company-module-ttu
vectors.why: access_bundle#admin has no direct-user alternative, only the two ttu branches

vectors.name: access-segment-admin-direct
vectors.why: access_segment#admin includes a direct this-tuple branch

vectors.name: access-segment-admin-via-company-module-ttu
vectors.why: no direct grant for this user; reaches admin via (admin from company_module)

vectors.name: access-segment-owner-deny
vectors.why: vec-bundle1-manager manages the bundle, not the segment's owner relation

vectors.name: unknown-object-type-fails-closed
vectors.why: object type not present in model.json at all

vectors.name: unknown-relation-fails-closed
vectors.why: timesheet_entry has no 'submitter' relation (that name exists only on company_module)

vectors.name: userset-cycle-answers-false
vectors.why: member_directory:vec-loop-a and vec-loop-b hold mutually recursive userset-subject 'editor' tuples with no base case; a cycle is cut at the in-progress node and answers false — never DEPTH_EXCEEDED, never a hang (the depth fence is for genuinely deep graphs: TestBatchCan's 34-link chain)

vectors.name: group-cycle-outsider-deny
vectors.why: group:vec-cyc-a#member and vec-cyc-b#member reference each other; a user in neither is denied on b (the cycle contributes nothing)

vectors.name: group-cycle-member-of-a-allowed-on-b
vectors.why: the same cycle, a direct member of a checked on b: reached through b -> a#member; the a -> b back-edge is cut, not fatal

vectors.name: position-bound-to-own-company
vectors.why: position#company is the anchor the decision layer binds a position check to the request's company through; the position in company A answers true against A

vectors.name: position-not-bound-to-other-company
vectors.why: the same position answers false against company B — a helpdesk holder check through B's URL path is denied before the holder relation is evaluated

vectors.name: group-bound-to-own-company
vectors.why: group#company: same anchor shape for groups

vectors.name: group-not-bound-to-other-company
vectors.why: the group in company A answers false against company B
